sources.tier: method-bearing working paper / Journal of Financial Markets
sources.authors: Abby Kim; Yiuman Tse; John K. Wald
sources.mechanism_claim: Time-series momentum results can be materially driven by volatility scaling rather than directional signal alone.
sources.implementation_lesson: Separate trend estimator from volatility/risk sizing and test their contributions independently; do not credit ATR scaling as directional alpha.
sources.limitations: Diversified international futures, not BingX crypto perpetuals; architecture evidence only.
sources.reproducibility: method described; ZEL implementation must be independently frozen

sources.mechanism_claim: Bollinger Bands have a statistical interpretation and can be used in mean-reversion/pairs contexts; the paper does not establish unconditional single-asset reversal alpha.
sources.implementation_lesson: Band excursion is a deviation proxy only; pair it with a frozen reverting/range regime and explicit duration/invalidation instead of oscillator-only reversal.
sources.limitations: Pairs/statistical framing differs from current single-asset legacy bb_revert.
sources.reproducibility: paper method inspectable; source-method mismatch must be explicit

sources.mechanism_claim: Stop-loss and take-profit orders cluster around salient levels; stop-loss clustering beyond levels can produce rapid continuation after crossings and take-profit clustering can contribute to reversals.
sources.implementation_lesson: A sweep/reclaim strategy needs level formation, crossing/reclaim direction and invalidation to be explicit; wick shape alone is an inadequate proxy for the payer mechanism.
sources.limitations: FX order data, not crypto; direct crypto portability is unproven and must be falsified prospectively.
sources.reproducibility: order-clustering mechanism documented; ZEL cannot observe private stops and must use public-price/order-flow proxies only

sources.mechanism_claim: Trading activity, volatility and liquidity show pronounced time-of-day patterns across many crypto exchanges despite 24/7 trading.
sources.implementation_lesson: Session/time features may condition opportunity and cost, but clock alone is not an entry signal; venue portability and matched placebo are required.
sources.limitations: Cross-exchange stylized facts do not prove directional return alpha on BingX.
sources.reproducibility: large multi-exchange study; ZEL requires BingX matched-placebo replication

sources.authors: Peter Reinhard Hansen; Chan Kim; Wade Kimbrough
sources.mechanism_claim: BTC/ETH volatility and volume have systematic day/hour/within-hour periodicity linked in part to algorithmic trading and futures funding times.
sources.implementation_lesson: Clock/session policy must separate periodic liquidity/volatility state from directional trigger and use placebo/time-shift controls.
sources.limitations: Coinbase/Binance/Uniswap evidence, not BingX-specific directional economics.
sources.reproducibility: paper provides defined periodicity measurements; venue-specific validation required

sources.mechanism_claim: Bitcoin showed negative first-order autocorrelation at 1h/2h/4h in the studied sample, with larger moves followed by stronger reversals; proposed explanations include overreaction, excess volatility and cascading liquidations.
sources.implementation_lesson: For mean-reversion candidates, prior-move magnitude and causal horizon may matter more than unconditional RSI/Bollinger thresholds; liquidation/jump regime must be distinguished from ordinary range reversion.
sources.limitations: Historical Bitcoin sample and retrospective algorithm; not current BingX survivor evidence.
sources.reproducibility: time-horizon claim explicit; prospective ZEL falsification required

anchor_vwap_trend.economic_mechanism: trend continuation after price accepts above/below a volume-weighted anchor while directional structure persists
anchor_vwap_trend.payer_constraint: late counter-trend liquidity/position adjustment during persistent directional flow; hypothesis only
anchor_vwap_trend.source_method_fidelity: Legacy ZEL uses swing-anchored VWAP + EMA trend + ATR/candle reclaim. External momentum evidence supports separating trend estimator from volatility scaling, not this exact combined rule.
anchor_vwap_trend.entry_event: to be frozen after Feature SSOT reconstruction; anchor acceptance/reclaim plus directional trend, not arbitrary indicator vote
anchor_vwap_trend.regime_no_trade: trend persistence required; block excessive chase and structurally weak/invalid anchor states
anchor_vwap_trend.risk_exit: ATR/structure invalidation and runner/pyramiding must be policy-owned; adds only after favorable progress
anchor_vwap_trend.whole_architecture_falsification: directional trigger must add positive prospective contribution over matched trend/volatility controls after realistic costs

bb_revert.economic_mechanism: temporary overreaction/deviation that reverts toward a local equilibrium only in a stable reverting regime
bb_revert.payer_constraint: liquidity demand/overreaction and leveraged overshoot; hypothesis only
bb_revert.source_method_fidelity: Legacy single-asset Bollinger+RSI+EMA gate differs from the statistical/pairs framing of arXiv:1212.4890; mismatch is explicit.
bb_revert.entry_event: extreme deviation plus observable reversal/reclaim in a predeclared non-trending regime
bb_revert.regime_no_trade: block trend/jump/liquidation-cascade transition unless the architecture specifically models post-shock reversal
bb_revert.risk_exit: equilibrium target plus structural failure/time stop; adverse-move averaging prohibited
bb_revert.whole_architecture_falsification: reversion event must outperform time-shift/regime-permuted controls net of frozen costs; otherwise reject the specification

liquidity_sweep.economic_mechanism: clustered stops/liquidity around salient levels may cause transient overshoot or rapid continuation; reclaim vs acceptance determines direction
liquidity_sweep.payer_constraint: forced stop execution and liquidity-demand imbalance near clustered levels; public proxy only
liquidity_sweep.source_method_fidelity: Osler observes actual FX orders; ZEL has no private stop book. Legacy wick+swing proxy is therefore indirect and must not be presented as direct stop-flow measurement.
liquidity_sweep.entry_event: predeclared swing/level penetration followed by either reclaim or acceptance, with public trade/book confirmation if source-ready
liquidity_sweep.regime_no_trade: stale/low-quality book, excessive spread, ambiguous level, or no confirmation
liquidity_sweep.risk_exit: failure beyond swept/accepted level; turnover and expected move must dominate costs
liquidity_sweep.whole_architecture_falsification: sweep/reclaim classification must beat direction-flip and random-level controls after frozen execution costs

session_bias.economic_mechanism: time-of-day changes participation, volatility and liquidity; session is a conditioning variable rather than standalone directional alpha
session_bias.payer_constraint: global participant overlap and institutional trading-hour concentration alter opportunity/cost state
session_bias.source_method_fidelity: External studies establish periodicity, not the legacy hardcoded Asia/London/NY directional weights. Legacy fixed bias_strength values have no source authority and must not survive automatically.
session_bias.entry_event: directional event must be independent of clock; session/periodicity conditions regime and expected cost only unless a matched-placebo directional effect is demonstrated
session_bias.regime_no_trade: high spread/low depth or placebo-indistinguishable clock effect
session_bias.risk_exit: strategy-specific event invalidation; clock transition alone cannot invent exit without evidence
session_bias.whole_architecture_falsification: matched time-shift/placebo must show unique contribution beyond volatility/liquidity state; otherwise session component is removed
